_about: Public-domain Martin Luther (1483-1546) in English translations printed before 1930, each translator read on the title page: First Principles of the Reformation (ed. Wace and Buchheim, 1883), Table-Talk (tr. William Hazlitt), The Epistles of St. Peter and St. Jude (tr. E. H. Gillett, 1859), clean from CCEL; Works of Martin Luther vols. 1-2 (Philadelphia: Holman, 1915-16), Lenker's Epistle Sermons vols. 2-3 (1909) and Commentary on Genesis vols. 1-2 (1904, 1910), clean from Gutenberg; and from the Internet Archive the Galatians in its 16th-century English version (London, 1839), The Bondage of the Will (tr. Henry Cole, 1823) and Lenker's Church Postil gospel sermons (5 vols, 1904-07). Works vols. 3-6 (1930-32) and every later translation are left out. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
